responsibility: Implements computation and folding of __builtin_object_size and __builtin_dynamic_object_size in GIMPLE SSA form. It tracks per-SSA-name upper/lower and object/subobject size estimates, derives sizes through pointer arithmetic, allocations, calls, and control flow, materializes dynamic size expressions when possible, and runs both early and regular optimization passes that replace builtin calls with constants or simplified expressions while requesting any necessary SSA updates.
same_name_distinction: Implements the SSA-based analysis and optimization passes for __builtin_object_size and __builtin_dynamic_object_size, including size propagation and builtin folding/replacement. Unlike gcc/tree-object-size.h, this file contains the analysis engine and pass execution code.
